Frequently asked

What to expect.

Every engagement is scoped before testing begins. The goal is clear evidence, minimal disruption, and findings your team can act on.

How is an engagement scoped?+

We align on objectives, in-scope systems, testing windows, rules of engagement, stakeholders, and reporting needs before work begins.

Will testing disrupt production?+

Testing is planned to reduce operational risk. Higher-impact techniques are discussed and approved before use, with escalation contacts agreed in advance.

What do we receive at the end?+

You receive clear findings, supporting evidence, business context, remediation guidance, and a walkthrough. Retesting can validate completed fixes.

Can services be combined?+

Yes. Red, blue, cloud, application, and advisory work can be sequenced into a focused improvement program.
